title: Oracle → Aurora: AWS SCT Pre-Assessment
description: Run AWS Schema Conversion Tool (SCT) against Oracle source to assess conversion complexity before DMS setup.

steps.action: Install AWS SCT and connect to Oracle source (JDBC driver required)
steps.verify: SCT shows Oracle schema tree with table/proc counts

steps.action: Run SCT Assessment Report: Actions > Create Report > Full Assessment
steps.verify: Report PDF generated with green/yellow/red conversion complexity breakdown

steps.action: Review red-flagged objects (stored procs, triggers, sequences) and document manual conversion items
steps.verify: Manual conversion list exported to CSV/spreadsheet

steps.action: Run SCT Convert Schema on green/yellow objects
steps.verify: Aurora PostgreSQL DDL scripts generated without errors in SCT output pane

steps.action: Apply converted DDL to Aurora PostgreSQL staging cluster
steps.verify: psql \dt shows all converted tables; row count = 0 (empty, pre-load)
